title: Group O: nO antigens, bOth antibodies
body: Picture a cat sitting on the blood bank bench refusing to share: 'I have nO antigens and bOth antibodies — I am the universal red cell donor, but do NOT ask me for plasma.'
punchline: Universal RBC donor ≠ universal plasma donor.
scientificFact: Group O red cells lack A and B antigens; group O plasma contains anti-A and anti-B, which is why high-titre group O plasma must be handled carefully in platelet and plasma transfusions.

title: RDW variety show
body: RDW high = may sizes ang RBCs (variety show). RDW normal = pare-parehas lang (thala-thalassemia trait, boring pero classic).
punchline: Kung variety, iron deficiency. Kung uniform, thal trait.
scientificFact: RDW measures red cell size distribution; it is typically elevated in iron deficiency anemia and usually normal in thalassemia trait.
